COURSE_TITLE: Public Service Rules & Code of Conduct
COURSE_OBJECTIVE: Equip officers with a working knowledge of the Public Service Rules, the Code of Conduct for public officers, and the standards of behaviour expected in government service.
COURSE_DESCRIPTION: A practical introduction to the rules that govern appointment, conduct, discipline and accountability in the public service, with real-world scenarios on gifts, conflict of interest and asset declaration.

course_lessons.TITLE: Introduction to the Public Service Rules
course_lessons.DESCRIPTION: The Public Service Rules (PSR) set out the conditions of service for federal public officers: appointment, confirmation, promotion, leave, discipline and retirement. This lesson walks through how the PSR is structured, how it relates to circulars issued by the Office of the Head of the Civil Service of the Federation, and where officers can find the provisions that apply to them.

course_lessons.TITLE: Conflict of Interest, Gifts & Hospitality
course_lessons.DESCRIPTION: A conflict of interest arises when an officer's private interests could improperly influence the performance of official duties. This lesson covers how to recognise conflicts, how to declare them, and how to handle gifts and hospitality from contractors, vendors and members of the public.
